title: Slow Analytics · Decoupled Queues
brief: A heavy ad-hoc SQL query locks the Analytics data warehouse. The analytics consumers slow to a crawl, and processing latency jumps from 150ms to 2,500ms per batch.

event.description: Analytics worker latency degrades 15×; events accumulate in the Kafka queue.

prediction.prompt: Do viewers actively streaming the cricket match notice video stuttering or stream latency increases? (Yes / No)

misconceptions.true: Even though analytics consumers are heavily degraded, they sit behind an asynchronous message queue! Asynchronous edges are completely decoupled from the synchronous video streaming critical path.

palette.label: Scale Analytics Consumer Workers
palette.description: Triple consumer worker replicas (from 3 to 9) to drain queue backlog.
